# nextjs-template Copilot Instructions

This is the Next.js 12 frontend theme for the `sotoy` Dendron knowledge base. It consumes static JSON/HTML data generated by `dendron publish` and renders it as a navigable site.

## Routing

- `pages/index.tsx` handles `/` (root) using `getStaticPropsUtil`.
- `pages/[...slug].tsx` handles all other routes; slug is `note.fname.split(".")`.
- Never add `[[...slug]].tsx` — it conflicts with `index.tsx` on the root route.
- Import paths from any file in `pages/` must use `../` to reach `components/` or `utils/`.

## Data layer

All data is in `data/` (written by `dendron publish`, never edit manually):
- `data/notes.json` — all note metadata
- `data/notes/{id}.html` — rendered note body
- `data/dendron.config.json` — site config

Use `utils/build.ts` exports to access data at build time. Do not read `data/` directly in components.

## Component conventions

- All components live in `components/` and are named `DendronXxx.tsx`.
- Use functional React components with TypeScript.
- Do not create new pages that bypass the slug-based routing.

## What to avoid

- Editing anything in `data/` — it is generated output.
- Using `../../` import paths from files inside `pages/`.
- Adding optional catch-all routes that overlap `index.tsx`.
- Changing the `distDir` or `DATA_DIR` env vars without updating `env/server.ts`.
